analyst_view.overall: Juventus are 5th with 10 points and a win would move them close to a top-eight place; Omonia (18th, 6 points) are in the play-off places but lost their last two European games. Luciano Spalletti's side beat Venezia 4-0 on Saturday, but the injury list is long: the numbers now count Locatelli, Nico Gonzalez, Kalulu and Alajbegovic (shin, still being assessed), while Kenan Yildiz (fractured foot, about three months) is on the list but has not moved their goal figure. Thuram and Grabara are also out, and Juventus have no suspensions or players one booking from a ban. Omonia, under Henning Berg, drew 1-1 with APOEL; Christou is out, Magiabela is doubtful after feeling discomfort before the derby, and one Cypriot report wonders whether Berg will put the league game with Nea Salamina first. No referee named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals (Juventus 1.8, Omonia 0.9) and already take a little off for Locatelli, Nico Gonzalez and Alajbegovic and add some back for Kalulu missing in defence. They have not taken anything off for Yildiz, Juventus's main creator, so I lean a little lower, to about 2.6; a possibly rotated Omonia keeps this small.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.8 corners, mostly Juventus (8.0), already up for their 44 corners in the last six games. Omonia are likely to defend deep in Turin, which the split already shows, so I stay at 10.8.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.6 cards, already trimmed because Juventus draw few bookings from opponents lately (5 in six) and Omonia have been calm. A one-sided game with Omonia defending tends to stay quiet, no Juventus player is one booking from a ban, and no referee is named yet, so I stay at 3.6.

shots.text: The numbers say 30.6 shots, with Omonia's recent shooting already adding about 15% to their side. Without Yildiz Juventus lose their most direct dribbler and shooter, though a weakened Omonia could give them more of the ball, so I shade it only slightly, to about 30.0.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.2 shots on target, 7.6 of them for Juventus. With Yildiz out and Alajbegovic still being assessed, the front line relies on Woltemade, Kolo Muani and Conceicao, so I go slightly lower, to about 10.0.
